name: Large-Format Tile: Why Flat Subfloors Decide the Whole Job
meta-description: Large-format tile lives or dies on substrate flatness: the 1/8-inch-in-10-feet rule, lippage, back-buttering, and what Shoreline remodels need priced first.
post-summary: November 24, 2026 · Any tile with an edge 15 inches or longer plays by stricter rules: flatness to 1/8 inch in 10 feet, back-buttering on every tile, and a 33% cap on the offset. Here is why the flattening line item decides the whole job, and why Shoreline's mid-century remodels almost always need it.
